name: E-Skoch-Open
summary: This EA implements a Skoch-based open breakout strategy that enters trades when price breaks through dynamically calculated levels. It uses the Stochastic oscillator combined with price action breakout logic to identify entry opportunities. The system manages positions with stop loss and take profit levels derived from the breakout range.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了基于Skoch指标的突破开仓策略，当价格突破动态计算的关键水平时进场交易。它结合随机指标与价格行为突破逻辑来识别入场机会，并通过突破区间推导止损和止盈水平进行仓位管理。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于Stochastic（随机）指标与价格突破的结合。入场条件方面，当Stochastic指标从超买或超卖区域反转且价格突破近期关键高低点时，系统发出交易信号——向上突破做多，向下跌破做空。出场条件包括固定比率的止盈止损，以及Stochastic指标反向交叉时的信号平仓。仓位管理采用手数参数化设置，支持固定手数交易。资金管理方面，EA依赖用户合理设定手数和止损幅度，未内置动态仓位调整或风险百分比计算机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，但在极端行情下可能因固定止损不足而面临较大滑点风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy combines the Stochastic oscillator with price breakout logic for trade entries. Entry conditions trigger when the Stochastic reverses from overbought or oversold zones and price simultaneously breaks through recent swing highs or lows—long on upside breakout, short on downside breakdown. Exit conditions include fixed-ratio stop loss and take profit levels, as well as signal-based exits when the Stochastic makes a reverse crossover. Position sizing relies on a user-configured lot parameter with fixed lot trading, without dynamic position adjustment. Money management depends on the user setting appropriate lot sizes and stop loss distances, as the EA lacks built-in dynamic risk-percentage or equity-based position sizing. The strategy logic is clear overall, but may face significant slippage risk in extreme market conditions due to fixed stop loss levels.
pros: 策略逻辑清晰，Stochastic与突破结合减少假信号
参数化设计灵活，用户可调整关键参数适应不同市场
同时具备指标信号出场和固定止盈止损双重出场机制
交易信号基于多条件确认，避免单一指标误判
魔术编号支持多EA并行运行
pros_en: Clear strategy logic combining Stochastic with breakouts reduces false signals
Flexible parameterized design allows users to tune for different market conditions
Dual exit mechanism with both indicator-based and fixed SL/TP exits
Multi-condition confirmation for trade signals avoids single-indicator misjudgments
Magic number supports running multiple EAs simultaneously
cons: 缺乏动态仓位管理，固定手数无法适应账户规模变化
未包含新K线检测机制，可能在同一根K线多次开仓
无点差过滤，在小周期交易时可能因点差过大而亏损
缺少回撤控制机制，连续亏损时无自动停止功能
止损固定点数未考虑市场波动率（ATR）自适应调整
cons_en: Lacks dynamic position sizing—fixed lots cannot adapt to changing account size
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions on the same candle
No spread filter, which may cause losses on small timeframes when spreads widen
Missing drawdown control with no auto-stop after consecutive losses
Fixed pip stop loss does not self-adjust based on market volatility (ATR)
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈，适应市场波动率变化
添加新K线检测和点差过滤，防止重复开仓和高成本交易
引入基于账户余额百分比的风险仓位计算，替代固定手数
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to adapt to market volatility changes
Implement new bar detection and spread filter to prevent duplicate entries and costly trades
Introduce equity-percentage-based risk position sizing to replace fixed lot allocation

risk_points: 固定止损未考虑市场波动率，低波动时止损过大高波动时止损过小
无新K线检测可能导致同一K线重复开仓增加风险敞口
缺少最大回撤限制和连续亏损保护机制
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss ignores market volatility—too wide in low volatility, too tight in high volatility
No new bar check may cause duplicate position opening on the same candle, increasing exposure
Missing maximum drawdown limit and consecutive loss protection mechanism

It uses the Stochastic oscillator combined with price action breakout logic to identify entry opportunities. The system manages positions with stop loss and take profit levels derived from the breakout range.
